excluded_standalone_and_historical: dist/index.html and all other dist/assets files are unreachable from the installed remoteEntry.js graph.
notes: All eight packaged assets are byte-identical to the fixed installation capture and the existing light-media graph.
Public Git differs from the installed remoteEntry.js only in the spaces on one otherwise blank line. Packaging uses the installed bytes.

The fixed Vite source config declares optional Vuetify shares with generate:false. Only Vue is imported through the emitted share helper, which has no local module fallback. The host supplies globally registered Vuetify components and styles.

Config uses the original fixed class path plugin/SeedRescue/status. Page and AppPage render the same workbench, use the injected pluginId and load its scoped stylesheet. Dashboard remains a separately exported component.

The pinned upstream src tree, package.json and vite.config.js are the corresponding authored frontend inputs. The fixed upstream plugin has no lockfile. Packaging therefore preserves the installed emitted bytes.

source_clone_limitation.behavior: The original and target rewrite Pascal-case class references inside JavaScript but only replace lowercase spellings in generated filenames. As a result, clone Page and AppPage can reference a missing workbench chunk and stylesheet. Default-instance assets preserve the original reachable paths.
